name: Shame Core
description: Operates from a fundamental belief that they are defective at their core
behavioral_signature: Flinches from praise, sabotages success, avoids being truly seen
under_stress: Shame spirals into complete withdrawal or self-destruction
at_rest: Quietly certain they don't deserve good things
will_never: fully accept they deserve love or success
unless: unconditional acceptance is offered so persistently it erodes the shame
